translations.web: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
translations.bsb: His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.
translations.kjv: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
translations.asv: His archers compass me round about; He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.
